title: Call Roulette
description: Spin a wheel, call a friend. A tiny installable web app that picks someone from your contacts so you actually keep in touch.

title: Housing Simulator
description: An interactive simulation modeling housing markets, zoning policies, and their downstream effects over 50 years of NYC.

title: Kaighnbot
description: Claude Code on a MacBook in the corner of my apartment, texting my friends, making plans, and running my calendar.

title: OnlyKaighns
description: A parody of OnlyFans where the exclusive content is just a wall of photos of me. Subscribe to unlock everything (it's free, I just want your email).

title: Jeopardy
description: A real-time multiplayer Jeopardy! game with authentic episodes from the J! Archive: buzzers, Daily Doubles, Final Jeopardy wagering, and live chat over WebSockets.

title: Untitled Godot Game
description: An indie game blending Terraria's exploration, Factorio's automation, and tower defense strategy. Work in progress in Godot 4.
